text:
### Disputed Standing Order  
```
Exception: Customer claims unauthorized standing order to "Unknown Recipient"
Investigation: Found legitimate standing order to Mortgage Company (customer's mortgage)
Resolution: Educate customer on standing order setup, explain visibility in online banking
SLA: 2 business days
```

raw_entities.name: Disputed Standing Order Resolution Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for investigating and resolving customer disputes regarding standing orders. Includes investigation of claimed unauthorized standing orders, verification of legitimacy, customer education, and resolution within a defined SLA.
context: Exception: Customer claims unauthorized standing order to "Unknown Recipient"
Investigation: Found legitimate standing order to Mortgage Company (customer's mortgage)
Resolution: Educate customer on standing order setup, explain visibility in online banking
SLA: 2 business days

raw_entities.name: Dispute Receipt and Exception Logging
raw_entities.description: Initial step where customer's claim of unauthorized standing order is received and logged as an exception in the system.
context: Exception: Customer claims unauthorized standing order to "Unknown Recipient"

raw_entities.name: Standing Order Legitimacy Investigation
raw_entities.description: Investigation step to verify the standing order details and determine whether the standing order is legitimate or unauthorized. In this case, the investigation confirmed the standing order was legitimate.
context: Investigation: Found legitimate standing order to Mortgage Company (customer's mortgage)

raw_entities.name: Customer Education and Resolution
raw_entities.description: Resolution step involving customer education on standing order setup procedures and explanation of how standing orders are visible in online banking systems.
context: Resolution: Educate customer on standing order setup, explain visibility in online banking

raw_entities.name: Dispute Investigation Officer
raw_entities.description: Operations staff member responsible for investigating the disputed standing order claim and determining its legitimacy.
context: Investigation: Found legitimate standing order to Mortgage Company (customer's mortgage)

raw_entities.name: Customer Service Representative
raw_entities.description: Customer service staff responsible for educating the customer on standing order setup and online banking visibility features.
context: Resolution: Educate customer on standing order setup, explain visibility in online banking

raw_entities.name: Standing Order to Mortgage Company
raw_entities.description: A legitimate standing order set up by the customer to pay their mortgage company. Initially disputed by the customer as unauthorized but confirmed as legitimate during investigation.
context: Investigation: Found legitimate standing order to Mortgage Company (customer's mortgage)
